sentence: This project provides immune assays to discover biomarkers that predict cancer outcome or therapeutic response.
This project develops imaging methods and radiotracers that combine MRI with a complementary imaging type to study the heart, brain and immune function.
This project develops computer-based methods for designing protein structures and complexes.
This project builds an imaging method that uses deep learning with optical breast imaging and x-ray mammography to see small lesions more clearly.
This project tries to find out which neurons in the insular cortex sense the body's internal state, using a molecular technique that identifies active neurons.
This project provides drug development services that use structural biology, screening and medicinal chemistry to find molecular targets and chemical leads for cancer therapeutics.
This project uses chromatin imaging and computational modeling to study how chromatin structure relates to cancer stem cells and chemotherapy resistance in ovarian cancer.
This project builds and improves mass spectrometry methods to measure proteomes, post-translational modifications and accessible cysteines more accurately and efficiently.
This project tries to find non-coding genome variants that respond to an environmental chemical and change gene expression and neural cell fate in autism.
This project studies how environmental and social factors, including air pollution and radon, relate to mammographic features.
This project supports the creation of genetically modified animal models and cell lines using genome editing technologies.
This project studies how diabetes develops after acute pancreatitis by enrolling well-characterized individuals in a study of its risk factors and mechanisms.
This project studies how early life overnutrition affects neural circuits in the hypothalamus that are essential for energy balance and time of day.
This project develops machine learning methods that combine measurements of chromatin 3D architecture with other data to understand how genome structure relates to function.
This project develops imaging tools for children with cancer that measure treatment effects while keeping radiation exposure as low as possible.
This project tests mobile health tools that help community health workers fit and support low-cost hearing aids.
This project develops high-resolution MRI methods to measure iron and myelin in mesoscale brain structures.
This project studies how donor macrophages, a type of immune cell, contribute to acute cellular rejection after heart transplant.
This project studies how genotype, innate immunity and meningeal lymphatics affect amyloid deposits along blood vessels in the brain.
This project tries to find mechanisms that establish and maintain pluripotency in stem cells.
